claims.statement: A certificate must currently be supplied for specified building sale or rental events, and an eligible professional must prepare it; each qualifying transaction creates a paid service event.
Certificates generally last ten years but expire earlier after works changing energy performance, producing event-driven repeat demand rather than annual renewal.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: Property manager, estate agency operations head or notary-adjacent transaction coordinator
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Embedded ordering, document completeness and licensed-assessor capacity inside the property workflow resist a standalone certificate shop.
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: The prospective business would own agency or property-manager service contracts; assessors retain professional responsibility and agencies retain sellers and landlords.
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Workflow integrations and nonexclusive referral agreements with property managers and estate agencies.

fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Prepaid per order or monthly consolidated billing.
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Assessor coordination and exception handling estimated at 30-60 minutes per order.
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Professional verification, security, complaints and insurance estimated at 10,000 PLN monthly.
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Per-certificate transaction fee and API fee.
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Licensed assessor payout, payment fees and document support.

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Certificate marketplaces may offer agency integrations; local capacity reliability and SLA become key.
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: Owner or agent pays for a certificate at a qualifying sale, rental, completion or post-renovation event.
commercial_mechanics.payer: Property owner, manager, developer or estate agency
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: Listing, lease signing, sale closing, building completion or qualifying renovation.
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Next transaction or performance-changing renovation; not normally annual.

contrary_evidence: Certificates remain valid for ten years absent relevant works, limiting repeat frequency per property.
Low-cost direct assessors can compress marketplace take rates.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Unknown; proposed nonexclusive assessor capacity and property-workflow integration agreements are unsigned.
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Operate direct consumer ordering with multiple replaceable assessors and CSV intake before integrations.
critical_control_point.current_owner: Licensed assessors control certificate issuance; property intermediaries control transaction workflows.
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: The prospective business would own agency or property-manager service contracts; assessors retain professional responsibility and agencies retain sellers and landlords.
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: No current property-channel or assessor-capacity rights.
critical_control_point.launch_controller: The founder would control order routing and API; licensed assessors control professional issuance.
critical_control_point.renewal: Unknown; proposed annual integrations and per-order assessor terms.
critical_control_point.subject: Energy-certificate ordering workflow

economics.acquisition_route: Aggregate ten nonexclusive assessors, manually serve two agencies, then expose ordering and status APIs.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Assumption: 30,000 orders annually at 180 PLN net revenue produces 5.4M PLN revenue; at 15% owner earnings and a 6x workflow-platform value, a 70% stake could approach 5M PLN in years 7-10. Order density and take rate are unknown.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Order price less assessor payout and direct support; target 35%.
economics.payback: Agency saves coordination time and reduces closing delay; founder CAC target below 100 fulfilled orders.
economics.pricing: 450-900 PLN retail with 120-250 PLN platform net; API minimum 500 PLN monthly.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Agencies and property managers generate recurring transaction orders.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Assessor reliability, turnaround and property-input completeness data.
fingerprint.customer: Estate agencies, property managers and residential developers.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Embedded workflow integration and referral contracts.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Property stakeholder pays per qualifying certificate event.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A sale, rental, completion or renovation requires documentation.

risks: Channels may build direct assessor panels

structural_signature.commercial_model_descriptor: energy certificate ordering and capacity api

structure.control_point: Certificate order embedded before property completion
structure.critical_dependency: Licensed assessor supply and channel integration

thesis: Aggregate replaceable licensed-assessor capacity and embed ordering at the legally triggered property transaction.
title: Energy Certificate Transaction API
